div.div: 1.1 The Landlord leases, and the Tenant accepts a lease of, the Premises for the Term subject to this Contract. By signing this Contract, the Tenant confirms that: (i) the Tenant has inspected the Premises; (ii) the Premises are in good condition; and (iii) the Tenant accepts the Premises on the Commencement Date on an "as is where is" basis.

1.2 Subject to this Contract and any rules applicable to the Premises and/or the Building/Community ("Rules", which the Tenant acknowledges it has received, read and understood), the Tenant may use: (i) any allocated carpark space(s) (as notified by the Landlord) on a license basis; and (ii) any unallocated car parking at the Building/Community (both for parking cars only). The Landlord reserves the right to allocate and charge for any unallocated car parking at the Building/Community in the future.

2.1 The Tenant will pay the Rent by equal quarterly payments in advance, and all other payments in this Contract as and when applicable by cheque, without demand, deduction or set-off. The Late Payment Fee is payable on all payments under this Contract which are not paid on the due date.

2.2 All amounts payable under this Contract are exclusive of tax, such as value added tax ("VAT"). If VAT is payable under this Contract, the amount payable for the supply (VAT exclusive) will be increased by the amount of VAT applicable at the prevailing rate at the time the amount is invoiced/supply is made, and the Tenant agrees to pay the same.

2.3 The Tenant warrants that: (i) an improper payment has not been, and will not be, made to any party or person in relation to this Contract; (ii) all payments made under this Contract are (and will be) made by the Tenant unless the Tenant obtains the Landlord's prior written consent (at its discretion) to a third party making payments on the Tenant's behalf (and in such case, the Tenant warrants that the Tenant has authorized such payment to be made); and (iii) all payments made by the Tenant (or any third party) under this Contract are from legitimate sources and are not directly or indirectly related to proceeds of crime/money laundering.

3.1 The Security Deposit will be held as security for the Tenant's obligations under this Contract. If the Tenant does not comply with this Contract, the Landlord may deduct any payment or fees due under this Contract and/or all costs and expenses incurred in connection with and/or remedying such breach ("Deductions"), without the requirement for notice or to obtain a judicial order. If Deductions are made and/or if the payments, fees, costs and/or expenses exceed the Security Deposit, the Tenant will immediately reinstate the Security Deposit and/or immediately pay to the Landlord such increased amount.

3.2 At the end of the Term (except pursuant to Clause 10.2), if the Tenant has complied with this Contract and has provided the Tenant's nominated bank account details, the Landlord will return the Security Deposit (less any Deductions) within forty-five (45) days. If the Tenant fails to provide the Tenant's nominated bank account details to the Landlord within six (6) months from the termination date, the Tenant waives its right to, and agrees that the Landlord may retain, the Security Deposit (or balance thereof). No interest is payable on the Security Deposit.

4.1 The Tenant will pay, and indemnifies the Landlord against the cost of all utilities and services provided to the Premises, and/or outgoings assessed or charged on the Premises or which are payable by the owner or occupier of the Premises ("Utilities"), which include connection, supply and consumption of gas, electricity, telecommunications, water sewage and cooling (including demand/capital and any other charges), and fees and taxes (including any housing fee or tax, or property fees). Full payment will be made without demand, deduction or set-off, and regardless of any deductions that may be applicable under law (if applicable). If paid by the Landlord, the Tenant agrees to reimburse the Landlord for the same upon demand.

4.2 If the Premises does not have a separate utility meter, the Tenant will allow the Landlord access to the Premises to install the same. Once the separate utility meter is installed, the Tenant will take all necessary steps to connect and register the Premises to such meter. The Tenant will pay all registration/connection costs.
5.1 The Tenant will only use the Premises for the Permitted Use and will not exceed the Occupancy Limit.

5.2 The Tenant: (i) will keep, maintain and repair the Premises in good condition, at the Tenant's cost; and (ii) will not make any alterations or additions to the Premises whatsoever (including without limitation, installing carpets or wallpaper, signage or antenna/satellite dishes).

5.3 The Tenant will not (i) cause any nuisance to other occupiers of the Building/Community, including placing any items outside the Premises; or (ii) cause any damage to the Premises and/or Building/Community; or (iii) use or store any hazardous items (including gas cylinders) at the Premises and/or Building/Community without the Landlord's prior written consent. If any items are left outside the Premises at any time, the Tenant waives all rights to, and agrees that the Landlord may remove and dispose of, such items in the Landlord's entire discretion, at the Tenant's cost, without compensation to the Tenant.

5.4 During the Term the Tenant will at its own cost, obtain and maintain an insurance policy for the Tenant's (and its Occupiers) assets/items at the Premises against loss or damage by fire, theft or flood, and for third party liability (including tenant's liability) to a limit acceptable to the Landlord (and will provide a copy of the same to the Landlord promptly on request). The Tenant agrees not to do or omit to do anything which may make void or voidable, or prejudice any claim under, any policy of insurance maintained by the Tenant and/or the Landlord.

5.5 The Tenant will comply with and ensure that the Tenant's occupiers and visitors ("Occupiers") comply with, this Contract, the Rules, the law, and any regulations by relevant authorities. The Tenant agrees that a breach of any Rule is a breach of this Contract and that the Landlord may update the Rules from time to time.

5.6 The Tenant will permit the Landlord (and representatives) access to the Premises to: (i) on prior notice to view the condition of, carry out repairs, maintenance and/or alterations to the Premises, Building/Community or any part thereof; and (ii) immediately without notice in an emergency (even in the absence of the Tenant).

5.7 The Landlord has the right to charge, and the Tenant will pay on demand, any fees as set out at Clause 12 and/or as may be set out for violations/penalties in the Rules (if applicable). The Landlord may revise the fees from time to time, by written notice to the Tenant. The Tenant is liable for and will reimburse the Landlord for all costs incurred enforcing this Contract (if required), including legal notices, costs and judicial fees.

6.1 The Landlord is only responsible to provide major maintenance to the Premises as the Landlord determines necessary, unless the damage is caused by the Tenant or its Occupiers and/or as a result of the Tenant's failure to comply with this Contract (in which case, the Landlord will repair or require the Tenant to repair such damage as determined necessary by the Landlord, all at the Tenant's cost). The Tenant is responsible to provide all other cleaning, maintenance and repairs at the Premises. The Tenant will not claim any compensation for any damage to the Premises which: (i) is caused by the Tenant or its Occupiers; or (ii) occurs as a result of an accident or natural disasters, or non-notification by the Tenant to the Landlord in due time to prevent such damage. If required by the Landlord, the Tenant will only use maintenance providers approved by the Landlord.
7.1 The Landlord has the right to amend this Contract by giving the Tenant two (2) months written notice prior to the Expiry Date.

7.2 If the Tenant does not wish to renew this Contract, the Tenant will provide the Landlord with at least two (2) months written notice prior to the Expiry Date (three (3) months prior written notice is required if the Tenant is not an individual). The Tenant acknowledges that by failing to provide the Landlord with such notice, loss and damage will be directly caused to the Landlord (such as delays in reinstating the Premises and/or re-leasing the Premises). If the Tenant does not provide such notice, in lieu of such notice being provided, the Tenant agrees to pay compensation to the Landlord equal to two (2) months' Rent (or three (3) months' Rent, if the Tenant is not an individual).

7.3 If the Tenant remains in occupation of the Premises after the Expiry Date, this Contract will be automatically renewed for a period equal to the Term (unless otherwise agreed). If this Contract is renewed, the Tenant agrees: (i) that the form of this Contract will be updated to the Landlord's then standard form of (renewal) contract (including any notified amendments, if any); (ii) that the Rent will not decrease but will be increased to the maximum permitted by law; and (iii) to pay the Administration Fee. If the Landlord agrees to renew this Contract for a period less than Term, the Tenant agrees that the renewed rent may be subject to a premium as determined by the Landlord (at the Landlord's sole discretion).

7.4 If the Tenant does not sign the renewal contract by the Expiry Date, the Tenant will pay the Late Renewal Fee (in addition to the Administration Fee). If the Tenant remains in occupation of the Premises after the Expiry Date (but does not enter a renewal contract), the Tenant will pay the Holding-Over Fee (in addition to the Rent calculated on a pro rata daily basis).

8.1 At the end of the Term (unless renewed), the Tenant will: (i) return all keys and security/access cards to the Premises and/or Building/Community; (ii) settle all final Utilities invoices and provide the Landlord with evidence of such payment; (iii) vacate, remove belongings, and return the Premises to the Landlord in good condition as existed when the Tenant first received handover and possession of the Premises, fair wear and tear excepted, to the Landlord's satisfaction (including cleaning, returning any painted surfaces to their original colour and condition, removal of any nails, hooks, screws, tacks and plaster over any holes in the wall, woodwork or doors). If the Tenant fails to inspect the Premises with the Landlord and/or countersign a condition report prepared by the Landlord, the Tenant agrees (and is deemed) to accept such condition report without objection.

8.2 If the Tenant fails to comply with Clause 8.1, the Tenant: (i) agrees that the Landlord may reinstate the Premises to the condition required under this Contract at the Tenant's cost; (ii) waives all rights to, and agrees that the Landlord may remove and dispose of, any items left inside (or outside) the Premises as the Landlord determines is appropriate and without compensation to the Tenant, without the requirement for notice or judicial order; and (iii) acknowledges that the Tenant remains liable to comply with this Contract (including making all payments due) until the Premises are returned to the Landlord in accordance with this Contract and the Landlord is able to re-lease the Premises.

9.1 If the Tenant breaches this Contract, the Tenant agrees: (i) that all payments under this Contract will automatically become due and the Landlord has the right to set-off any payments or cheques held against any payments due; (ii) to reimburse the Landlord against all costs, losses and liabilities incurred in respect of the Tenant's breach (including for example the cost of reinstating the Premises to the condition required by this Contract (such as removing any unauthorised alterations or additions to the Premises) and paying an apportionment of Rent calculated on a daily rate until such reinstatement works are completed); and (iii) without limitation to the foregoing, or Clauses 3 or 5.7, the Landlord may terminate this Contract in accordance with Clause 10.

10.1 The Tenant may terminate this Contract prior to the Expiry Date, subject to providing two (2) months prior written notice (three (3) months prior written notice is required if the Tenant is not an individual), paying the Early Termination Fee, and complying with this Contract.

10.2 The Landlord may immediately terminate this Contract and evict the Tenant from the Premises, without the need to obtain the Tenant's consent or a judicial order, if the Tenant: (i) breaches any term of this Contract and such breach is not remedied within thirty (30) days of written notice from the Landlord to do so; (ii) uses the Premises for illegal or immoral uses; (iii) intentionally or by the Tenant's negligence, causes damage and/or endangers the safety of the Premises and/or Building/Community; (iv) is adjudged bankrupt or becomes insolvent; or (v) if the Landlord is satisfied that the Premises have been abandoned, at the Landlord's discretion (all without requirement for written notice). The Early Termination Fee is payable if this Contract is terminated by the Landlord prior to the Expiry Date.

10.3 If this Contract is terminated by the Landlord, without prejudice to the Landlord's rights under this Contract (including at Clauses 8 and/or 9) or at law, and without requirement for notice or to obtain a judicial order, the Tenant agrees that the Landlord may: (i) retain all monies paid by the Tenant (including the Security Deposit) to the date of termination; (ii) claim against the Tenant for all damage and losses incurred by the Landlord; and (iii) re-enter and repossess the Premises, without compensation to the Tenant.

11.1 The Tenant's use of the Premises and Building/Community (including any carpark space) is at the Tenant's own risk and the Landlord (or Landlord's representatives) are not responsible or liable in any way whatsoever for any loss, damage or injury to any person or property howsoever caused.

11.2 The Tenant will indemnify, defend and hold harmless the Landlord (and Landlord's affiliates and representatives) from and against all losses, liabilities, damages, claims, costs and expenses incurred or suffered (including resulting from claims by third parties) during the Term whatsoever, including without limitation in relation to any breach of this Contract, or any damage to property or injury or fatality caused to any person directly or indirectly by any act or omission of the Tenant and/or its Occupiers, or that arises out of or is related to this Contract and/or the occupation or use of the Premises by the Tenant and/or its Occupiers.

11.3 The Landlord will not be liable to the Tenant in relation to: (i) interruption of any utilities during periods of inspection, maintenance or repair of the same; (ii) breakdown of, or defects in, any utilities, conduits and/or services serving the Premises; (iii) damage caused by an act or omission by the Tenant or its Occupiers; or (iv) events beyond the reasonable control of the Landlord.

11.4 In no circumstances will the Landlord be liable to the Tenant for any direct or indirect loss of profit or revenue or any punitive, special, indirect, incidental or consequential loss of any nature whatsoever, howsoever incurred, including without limitation, any loss of data, opportunity, contracts, business, or goodwill.

Without limiting the Landlord's rights under this Contract, the Rules or at law, the Tenant will pay the following fees as agreed compensation to the Landlord (which the Tenant agrees in each case is reasonable and is non-refundable) as and when applicable as set out below:
12.1 Ejari Fee: All fees required to register this Contract on the Ejari register (including the Landlord's Ejari administration processing fees); payable on or before the Effective Date.
12.2 Bounced Cheque Fee: AED 1,000; payable if a cheque does not provide cleared funds.
12.3 Cheque Deferral Fee: the higher of AED 250 or the Late Payment Fee; payable if the Landlord agrees to delay presentation of a cheque, at the Tenant's request.
12.4 Replace Cheque Fee: AED 250; payable if the Landlord agrees to replace a cheque, at the Tenant's request.

12.5 Early Termination Fee: Equal to two (2) months' Rent (or three (3) months' Rent; if the Tenant is not an individual); payable if the Tenant provides notice to terminate this Contract and/or vacates the Premises prior to the Expiry Date.

12.6 Late Payment Fee: Calculated at the rate of 15% per annum on a pro rata daily basis for each day that a payment under this Contract is not paid on the due date (until the date that payment (and applicable Late Payment Fee) is made in cleared funds).
12.7 Late Renewal Fee: Calculated as AED 50 (per unit) per day; payable for each day that the signed renewal contract and/or payments thereunder are not received, if this Contract is renewed.
12.8 Administration Fee: AED 500; payable (i) if this Contract is renewed; and (ii) upon each request by the Tenant for variation, consent and issuance of any no objection or certification letter.

12.9 Holding-Over Fee: AED 50 per day (in addition to the Rent) calculated on a pro rata daily basis for each day that the Tenant remains in the Premises after the Expiry Date, until the Tenant has: (i) signed the renewal contract; or (ii) vacated the Premises in accordance with this Contract.

13.1 The Landlord may assign, transfer or dispose of its interest in the Premises and/or this Contract to a third party without notice or the consent of the Tenant. The Tenant may not assign, transfer, sublease/sublet or share, mortgage, or grant any other security interest over the Premises and/or this Contract without the Landlord's prior written approval.

13.2 This Contract forms the entire agreement between the parties in respect of the lease of the Premises. The Tenant agrees that the Tenant has not entered into this Contract in reliance on any representation, warranty or statement made by or on behalf of the Landlord. Except as provided for herein, no variation or amendment to this Contract shall be binding on a party unless it is written and signed by both parties.

13.3 If any provision in this Contract is held to be illegal, void, invalid or unenforceable for any reason, the legality, validity and enforceability of the remainder of this Contract will not be affected. No party shall be deemed to have waived any right resulting from any failure to perform by another party unless it has made such waiver specifically in writing.

13.4 Expiry or termination of this Contract is without prejudice to any existing breaches of this Contract by either party. The following clauses shall survive expiry or termination: Clauses 2.3, 3.2, 4, 5.7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 and 13.

13.5 The Landlord may, from time to time, appoint and/or authorise a managing agent to perform all rights and obligations of the Landlord under this Contract. The Tenant shall co-operate with the Landlord's nominated agent at all times.

13.6 The Tenant agrees to provide on demand to the Landlord's satisfaction valid identification for the Tenant and its Occupiers, and if the Tenant is a corporate, copies of all requested corporate documentation.

13.7 The Tenant confirms that the address and electronic contact details (email) set out above are correct, and are the Tenant's legal address to which the Landlord will send all correspondence and judicial/legal notices under this Contract.
13.8 The Tenant agrees that the Landlord may obtain a credit report from the relevant authority (currently Al Etihad Credit Bureau) at the Tenant's cost.

13.9 This Contract may be signed: (i) in hard copy or electronically in accordance with the Landlord's procedures and requirements; and/or (iii) in one or more counterparts, all of which taken together shall constitute one (1) instrument.

13.10 This Contract will be governed by the laws of Dubai, UAE. Disputes relating to this Contract will be referred to the Dubai Rental Disputes Settlement Center, or such replacement body with jurisdiction to resolve landlord and tenant issues in Dubai, UAE.
